# Color Hunt

> A community-curated platform providing hand-picked color palettes for designers and artists to discover, create, and organize color inspiration.

Color Hunt is a design resource platform that aggregates color palettes across various aesthetic categories and styles. Users can browse trending palettes, create their own contributions, and build personal collections for their design projects.

## Key Topics

- Color Palettes
- Palette Discovery
- Design Inspiration
- Color Categories
- Seasonal Colors
- Palette Curation
- Design Tools
- Color Search
- Palette Collection
- Palette Gallery
- Color-Themed Collections
- Community Contributions
- Trending Palettes
- Design Resources

## Core Features

- [Color Hunt Homepage](http://colorhunt.co): Main landing page with hand-picked color palettes for design inspiration
- [Create Palette](http://colorhunt.co/create): Palette creation tool for contributing new color combinations to Color Hunt's collection
- [My Collection](http://colorhunt.co/collection): User collection management page for saving and organizing favorite color palettes
- [Popular Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/popular): Browse trending and most popular color palettes from the community
- [Random Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/random): Random palette generator for discovering unexpected color inspiration

## Aesthetic & Style Collections

- [Pastel Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/pastel): Curated collection of soft, muted pastel color palettes
- [Vintage Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/vintage): Vintage-themed color palette collection for retro design projects
- [Retro Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/retro): Retro-inspired color palette collection for nostalgic aesthetics
- [Neon Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/neon): Vibrant neon color palette collection for bold, eye-catching designs
- [Gold Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/gold): Gold-themed color palette collection for luxury and elegant designs

## Tone & Mood Collections

- [Light Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/light): Light shade color palette collection for bright and airy designs
- [Dark Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/dark): Dark shade color palette collection for moody and sophisticated aesthetics
- [Warm Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/warm): Warm-toned color palette collection for cozy and inviting designs
- [Cold Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/cold): Cool-toned color palette collection for fresh and modern aesthetics

## Seasonal Collections

- [Summer Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/summer): Seasonal summer color palette collection for vibrant and energetic projects
- [Fall Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/fall): Autumn-themed color palette collection for warm seasonal designs
- [Winter Palettes](http://colorhunt.co/palettes/winter): Winter seasonal color palette collection for cool and festive aesthetics
